an4.116:1.1: “Monks, there are four instances where heedfulness should be exercised.
an4.116:1.3: Abandon bodily misconduct, develop good bodily conduct:
an4.116:1.5: Abandon verbal misconduct, develop good verbal conduct:
an4.116:1.7: Abandon mental misconduct, develop good mental conduct:
an4.116:1.9: Abandon wrong view, develop right view:
an4.116:2.1: “When, in a monk, bodily misconduct is abandoned, good bodily conduct is developed; verbal misconduct is abandoned, good verbal conduct is developed; mental misconduct is abandoned, good mental conduct is developed; wrong view is abandoned, right view is developed, then he has no fear of death as it relates to the next life.”
